title: Florida used robot rabbits to hunt Burmese pythons threatening the Everglades

Developed by the South Florida Water Management District and University of Florida, the robotic decoys mimic prey using heat and scent while AI cameras detect approaching snakes. Officials can then alert trained removal agents, adding technology to Florida’s wider python control efforts.

title: US immigration authority has a 10-day deadline on home address

Changing addresses with the USPS does not automatically update records with USCIS. Immigrants are encouraged to use the online self-service change-of-address tool for a timely update. Paper forms can be submitted, but online updates are recommended for efficiency.

title: Auto driver earns Rs 75,000 a month, spends Rs 1.4 lakh on daughter’s education

The video highlights the difficult balance between education costs and financial stability working families face today. Viewers praised his commitment to prioritizing education against financial limitations.

title: British man, his wife among 6 killed in Athens explosion
content: an explosion caused a three-storey building to collapse in central Athens . a gas leak was suspected to be behind the blast, according to local reports . four american tourists were also killed in the blast . the tourists were reported missing after failing to arrive for their flight .

title: At least 12 dead in suicide bomb blast near police post in northwestern Pakistan
content: a suicide bomber detonated an explosives-laden vehicle at a police checkpoint in northwestern Pakistan . the attack took place in dera Ismail Khan, a district in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province . gunmen later opened fire on an ambulance carrying victims to a nearby hospital, killing a rescue worker and injuring two others .

title: 10 women dead in 2 months: South Africa probes possible links in Ekurhuleni killings
content: the body of another woman was found in Ekurhuleni, east of Johannesburg . the latest body was found early Saturday in Tembisa township, police said . police began investigating after the bodies of three women were found in July and August .

title: Bangladesh to replace planned sculptures at historic sites
content: the proposal is part of a plan to "rescope and repurpose" the Independence Monument project . the monument is a national memorial and public space located in Dhaka . it is notably associated with two pivotal moments in Bangladeshi history .

title: 2 more Naga men killed as ethnic violence flares up in Manipur again
content: two mao Naga men shot dead by unidentified gunmen at Senapati village . two others wounded in latest escalation in a Naga-Kuki conflict . at least 21 people - 11 Nagas and 10 Kukis - have been killed since Aug 27 .

title: 4 killed as helicopter crashes in field in Canada’s Quebec, probe launched
content: helicopter crashes in a field near Montreal, a major city in canada’s Quebec province . all four people on board were killed, police say . the helicopter crashed and caught fire near Rang des Écossais, off highway 10 .

title: After meeting, EC says officials will visit homes of those sent notices
content: a full meeting of the Election Commission of India decided to exempt electors who have got notices for being unmapped to the last SIR or over logical discrepancies . the EC also agreed to an independent audit of ECINET software though it rejected allegations that EROs were being locked out .

title: Kharge, Sonia and Rahul pay homage to late PM Manmohan Singh
content:
Congress leaders paid homage to former PM Manmohan Singh

NEW DELHI: Remembering him as a statesman and a visionary, Congress netas Mallikarjun Kharge, Sonia Gandhi and Rahul Gandhi Saturday led the party in paying homage to late Prime Minister Manmohan Singh on his birth anniversary. Congress held a ceremony at the party office where the Gandhis, senior functionaries and office-bearers paid floral tributes to Singh. A prayer meeting was also organised by Singh's family at their residence, which was attended by Rahul. On the occasion, All India Professionals Congress announced the second batch of "Dr Manmohan Singh fellows program", under which professionals join the party to work on issues ranging from policy to politics. Rajya Sabha MP Praveen Chakravarty and AIPC chairman Madhu Yaskhi Goud said the first batch had 50 fellows, while the second batch has been scaled up to 100.

End of Article

title: India, Bangladesh look towards Rahman visit in November
content:
Bangladesh PM Tarique Rahman

NEW DELHI: After an earlier attempt was aborted, India and Bangladesh are looking to schedule a visit by PM Tarique Rahman to India in the third week of Nov, sources said. Efforts to reschedule the visit are likely to gain momentum after the arrival of the new Bangladesh high commissioner, Asad Alam Siam, in the last week of Oct or early Nov. For Dhaka though, the key concern - one which might decide whether the visit materialises - is the unresolved issue of former PM Hasina's extradition. Rahman's birthday greetings to Modi and the latter's prompt response seem to have boosted the likelihood of an early finalisation of dates for the visit. However, neither side has confirmed - or denied - reports that NSA Ajit Doval travelled to Dhaka recently. The 'visit' was reported to have taken place on Sept 17.

End of Article

title: INDIA bloc to meet on Sept 30, CEC's ouster on top of agenda
content: the meeting is scheduled against the backdrop of nationwide outrage triggered by revelations that ECs SS Sandhu and Vivek Joshi had questioned many of the decisions regarding SIR . the opposition has said the revelations tie in with their allegations of 'vote chori' in favour of BJP over the last two years .

title: Bangkok under water as heavy rain disrupts life, more storms forecast
content: nearly 300 mm (12 inches) of rain fell in Bangkok within 48 hours . heavy rain and thunderstorms will continue across much of the country through Sunday . flooding posed a risk to lives and could damage public and private property, with areas near canals among the worst affected .

title: Election panel backs Form 6 for SIR, says SC upheld its use
content: EC retains mandatory SIR declaration for fresh voter enrolment . applicants will no longer need to attach a declaration mapping themselves or their relative to the electoral rolls from the last SIR . a statement put out by the three-member Election Commission justified the continued requirement of new electors to submit the declaration along with Form 6 as part of SIR, saying the declaration has been upheld by the Supreme Court .

title: Iran keeps door open for talks as Trump rejects Hormuz proposal
content: Iran FM Araghchi says Tehran awaiting formal response to Hormuz proposal . he reiterated Iran's position that reopening the strategic waterway would depend on conditions being met . "Only a negotiated solution can get them out of this deadlock," he added .

title: Jaishankar at UNGA: Pakistan serial practitioner of terror, must face outcome
content: EAM S Jaishankar says there must be no dilution of zero-tolerance approach to terrorism . he calls state-sponsored terrorism with a cross-border purpose a direct challenge to the global order . shehbaz Sharif had raked up the Kashmir issue in his speech on friday .

title: Beauty and the beast: China brought its own wheels, a red flag, to Washington
content: china's Hongqi N701, the heavily armoured state limousine used by Xi Jinping during his state visit to Washington . the limousine is an 18-foot rolling declaration that the country now has a beauty of its own to match America's "Beast" the symbolism was hard to miss .

title: PM Modi gave energy access to more than anyone in history: Aus PM
content:
Albanese highlights India’s energy connectivity under PM Modi.

NEW DELHI: Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has credited PM Narendra Modi with providing energy access to India's population on a scale that, he said, no other country has achieved before. Speaking at an event on Sept 24 organised by Asia Policy Institute in New York on the sidelines of UNGA meetings, he said, "To give PM Modi credit, more people have been connected with access to energy in India under his reign than has occurred in any decade in any country or any region in human history." Under the Ujjwala scheme, over 10.5 crore cooking gas connections have been provided since 2016, while the Saubhagya scheme helped electrify over 2.8 crore rural and poor urban households. The PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana has connected over 50 lakh households with solar energy. Albanese is likely to visit India in Dec when bilateral trade and cooperation in clean energy are expected to be discussed.

End of Article

title: J&K BJP bigwig meets HM day after CM moves statehood resolution with autonomy reference
content: BJP leader of opposition meets HM Amit Shah in new Delhi . he says BJP is prepared to debate restoration document brought by nc govt . but he would not accept attempts to “smuggle in” issues of Article 370 and 2000 autonomy resolution .

title: 'All misconceptions put to rest': NDA allies welcome EC press note amid SIR row
content: BJP allies in the party-led ruling National Democratic Alliance welcome the Election Commission of India's statement . a media report claims a rift between Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar and the two Election Commissioners, Sukhbir Singh Sandhu and Vivek Joshi, over the special Intensive Revision exercise . the order for the SIR issued on 24.6.2025 for all the States/UTs, starting with Bihar, followed by west Bengal and 30 other States

title: Merely 11% of IIT-B faculty from reserved categories: RTI
content: only about 11% of the faculty at IIT-B belong to reserved categories . of the 775 filled posts, only 84 are held by teachers from the SC, ST, OBC and EWS categories, according to student groups .

title: JKCA ‘scam’: Jammu and Kashmir HC rejects ED plea to add charges
content: ED's prayer for invoking sections 411 (dishonestly receiving stolen property) lacked merit based on the material currently available . HC set aside the trial court’s reasoning that ED lacks a “locus standi” to move such an application .

title: Sonam Wangchuk apologises for comparing Ladakh situation with Tibet
content: sonam Wangchuk apologises for comparing ladakh with Tibet . he said he meant only to highlight the gravity of the violence in leh on sept 24 last year . the leh Apex Body member apologised after the Central Tibetan Administration objected to his remarks as "misplaced and inaccurate"
